releaseSemantics.releasedMeans: This is a versioned, hash-verifiable identity and entitlement contract that a Doorstar consumer may pin exactly.
releaseSemantics.doesNotMean: It does not assert that Keycloak, JWKS, an entitlement resolver, a tenant membership, a Doorstar route, a Plant runtime, a device, a station, or a proof-of-possession verifier is active.

keyRotation.overlapRule: During a planned rotation, an issuer may publish old and new verification keys concurrently. A consumer verifies only a key with the exact protected-header kid and never tries every key.
keyRotation.retirementRule: After the old kid is absent from the published JWKS, it is denied on the next verification-key refresh and therefore within maximumVerificationKeyCacheSeconds. An emergency key compromise requires cache purge/restart or an equivalent operator-approved override; this static release does not perform that operation.
keyRotation.unknownKidRule: An unknown kid causes one bounded refresh of the configured JWKS source; a missing or still unknown kid is denied. A request must never supply a JWKS URL or key.

protectedHeader.rule: The consumer validates this protected JOSE typ before accepting payload claims. alg=none and every non-RS256 algorithm are denied.

audience.rule: A scalar audience, a missing member, a duplicate, or a third member is denied.

tokenType.rule: The signed payload typ is a distinct mandatory rule from protected JOSE typ=JWT.

principalDiscriminator.rule: The discriminator must be present as a top-level signed string and have this exact lowercase value.

subject.rule: A non-empty signed subject is required. Doorstar may derive a non-reversible local correlation key but must not take a subject from a request field.

time.rule: exp, nbf when present, and iat are validated before entitlement. iat must not be after exp.

nativeTenantProjection.tenantIdFormat: lowercase RFC-variant UUID, excluding reserved all-zero tenant identifiers
nativeTenantProjection.arrayRule: Each entitlement array is non-empty, duplicate-free, and lexicographically sorted. Unknown values grant no authority.

doorstarEntitlement.rule: A human Doorstar token carries exactly one recognized permission and exactly the Doorstar module. A generic realm role, another module, or a local capability map is not a substitute.

nativeTenantProjection.versionRule: Both version claims are top-level positive safe integers. Camel-case, flat, legacy, or alias version claims are not substitutes.

doorstarHumanConsumer.noFallbackOrUnion: Doorstar is a human-token consumer. It must reject, rather than reinterpret, service-principal, Plant, flat-projection, device, station, confirmation, or proof-of-possession semantics.

servicePrincipalToken.rule: A machine-to-machine service credential is a separate profile and may be accepted only by an explicitly configured service-principal consumer. It cannot acquire human authority through matching issuer, audience, azp, or a tenant-like field.

proofOfPossession.requestProof: DPoP proof must bind its public-key thumbprint to cnf.jkt and satisfy the Plant-owned method/URL/nonce/replay rules.
proofOfPossession.ownership: JoineryTech Plant owns runtime user/device/station identity, proof verification, replay protection, station authorization, and execution authority.

plantUserDeviceStationPopToken.rule: This is not a bearer-human profile and is not a fallback for a Doorstar Office consumer. Doorstar must reject it before any Plant or Office authority is derived.

onlineMembershipReadback.authoritySource: authoritative SpaceOS membership and entitlement resolver
onlineMembershipReadback.runtimeEndpoint: not asserted or activated by this release
onlineMembershipReadback.cacheRule: No cached readback may extend an authority grant. Each protected authority decision requires a current online readback bound to the already signature-validated token.
onlineMembershipReadback.bindingRule: Every listed value must exactly equal the signed human token projection after normalizing only the documented lowercase UUID representation. Do not select a different tenant, capability, date, or status automatically.
onlineMembershipReadback.revocationRule: active=false, a missing membership, an unresolved tenant, or an invalid readback is a deny. A token remains denied even when its signature and exp are otherwise valid.
onlineMembershipReadback.downgradeRule: Any permissions, modules, membership version, or projection version mismatch is a deny. A later local or token-derived expansion never overrides the readback.
onlineMembershipReadback.staleTokenRule: The signed integer iat must be greater than or equal to readback.accept_tokens_issued_at_or_after. A lower iat is a deny even before exp.
onlineMembershipReadback.unavailableRule: Readback outage, timeout, malformed response, or non-authoritative response is unavailable/fail-closed and grants no authority.
onlineMembershipReadback.tenantIsolationRule: The target local tenant must equal the one signed tenant_id and the one readback tenant_id. A token for another active tenant is denied; the request cannot select the tenant.

consumerAcceptance.sourceRefPolicy: A future immutable annotated tag and full commit id may supplement this content-addressed bundle only when recorded in a publication receipt. A consumer must reject any unrecorded branch or ref and must not replace hash verification with VCS selector trust.
